overview_description.description: Second is a company that specializes in providing developer tools, software, and web applications. Their main product, Second Step, is an automated code migration tool for developers. This tool is designed to streamline the process of code migration, making it more efficient and less prone to errors. In addition to this, Second also offers a range of other software development services and solutions. Their offerings are designed to support developers in their work, helping them to create high-quality, reliable software and web applications.

product.description: A service that scans codebases to identify security vulnerabilities, performance issues, redundancies, and code quality problems, generating reports and automated fixes via pull requests.
